headline: GIFT Nifty Signals Strong Rebound as Indian Markets Reopen Following Holiday

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty signals a strong rebound with analysts looking at 26,000 as a key hurdle to cross.
The market suffered a sharp sell-off on November 23, with Sensex dropping 1,484 points and Nifty slipping below 25,400.
Metal and banking stocks led the recent market decline, while IT stocks outshone.
Share markets were closed on November 24 for Guru Nanak Jayanti.
whatHappening: SpiceJet's daily flight operations have dropped to 20 as its operational fleet reduces to six aircraft.
PNGRB proposes new gas pipeline rules offering 14% returns to developers and shifting volume risk.
IKEA India registered a 14% revenue growth in FY26 and plans to expand to 30 stores.
Speculation over fresh tech layoffs in India grows following viral social media posts.
summary: GIFT Nifty indicates a positive opening for Indian markets on November 25 following a market holiday on November 24. This follows a major correction on November 23 where Sensex fell over 1,400 points. Individually, SpiceJet faces operational headwinds with flight services shrinking to 20 per day.
